title: BM25 lexical retrieval vs bounded QAM link traversal
subtitle: Deterministic retrieval and evidence evaluation — no LLM answer grading

cases.query: Which delivered machine variants use IOL-M8 directly, and which I/O mappings, PLC diagnostic blocks, parameter sets, and FAT/SAT cases must be reviewed for replacement? Exclude IOL-M8S and cite the relationship paths.
Article XK8-IO is being discontinued. Identify the exact component and every delivered machine variant that uses it; do not confuse it with XK8-IOS.
Engineering records call the obsolete device AL-8P. Resolve that alias and list the affected delivered variants without including the stainless IOL-M8S installation.
Which current service bulletin and controlled change govern the IOL-M8 replacement assessment? Reject superseded guidance.
For the impacted PKG-200 variant, return the variant, its I/O mapping, PLC diagnostic block, parameter set, and required FAT and SAT specifications for the IOL-M8 change.
For the impacted PAL-80 variant, return the variant, its I/O mapping, PLC diagnostic block, parameter set, and required FAT and SAT specifications for the IOL-M8 change.

Trace the separate IOL-M8S stainless-enclosure installation: identify its machine variant, I/O mapping, PLC diagnostic block, parameter set, FAT acceptance test, and service bulletin. Confirm that it is not part of the IOL-M8 obsolescence scope.
Which FAT and SAT specifications must be repeated for the delivered IOL-M8 installations, and through which machine variant is each test connected? Exclude the IOL-M8S FAT.

limitations: This run grades deterministic retrieval and evidence, not generated natural-language answers.
A single synthetic corpus does not establish statistical significance or universal superiority.
Both arms use the same query-derived terms, status/type scope, and concept-level top-k budget.
BM25 does not emit relationship paths; its path coverage is reported as not applicable.
A hybrid or GraphRAG baseline with entity resolution and traversal may reduce the observed gap.
